turns.content: I've started doing a short meditation in the morning. Just ten minutes but it's making a difference.
Ten minutes consistently is more valuable than longer sessions that come and go. How long have you kept it up?
About six weeks now. I use a guided app. The hardest part was making it the first thing I do before checking my phone.
Phone-free first thing is genuinely significant. The phone-first habit tends to set an anxious, reactive tone for the whole morning.
Exactly what I was finding. Even ten minutes of quiet before the news and emails feels like a buffer.
That framing — a buffer — is a useful way to think about it. Are you noticing any effect on the rest of the day?
I think so. I feel slightly less reactive. Whether it's the meditation or just placebo I'm not sure, but I'll take it.
The distinction matters less than the result. If the habit is working, the mechanism is secondary.
